serve hello.text
expand src_var.cel src.cel
cmpenv src.cel src_var.cel 

mito -cfg cfg.yaml -use http src.cel
cmp stdout want.txt
! stderr .

-- cfg.yaml --
http_headers:
  foo:
    - bar
    - baz
-- hello.text --
hello
-- src_var.cel --
// $URL is set by the serve command and ${URL} is expanded by the expand command.
post("${URL}", "text/plain", "").Request.Header
-- want.txt --
{
	"Content-Type": [
		"text/plain"
	],
	"foo": [
		"bar",
		"baz"
	]
}
